highlights: Air quality monitoring and external factor procedures
safety.policy_summary: Berkeley International School maintains a secure campus with 24-hour security guards, CCTV cameras, and automated flap-gates. The school implements a thorough child safeguarding policy involving annual staff training, background checks, and student support. Additionally, the school clinic is staffed with full-time nurses and medical equipment, and protocols are in place to monitor air quality and weather conditions.

facilities: air conditioned gym with raised maple flooring
